title: 第9章 西边捡来的项西(9)

content_zh:
至于是冷死的、毒死的还是……被项西一巴掌甩死的，就不知道了，也没人关心，这个话题最多聊到中午就不会再有人提起。
项西洗漱的时候很认真地洗了自己的手。
穿上外套的时候，平叔端着茶壶问了一句：“去哪儿？”
“医院。”项西说。
“昨天没去？”平叔盯着他，“骨头接不上别人该说我不疼你了。”
“要接不上昨儿去了也接不上。”项西拉开门。
二盘站在门外正要进来，看到他冷笑了一声：“接不上就接不上，跟你馒头哥做个伴。”
项西看了他一眼，勾了勾嘴角：“你也就这点儿本事了。”
甩上门走人之前，他听到二盘进屋跟平叔挺大声地说：“这种浑身倒刺的玩意留着干吗！早晚出事！”
项西往地上啐了一口，他不怕二盘，他被平叔捡回来的时候，二盘还不知道跟哪儿坑蒙拐骗地混着呢。
略微还让他有那么一点儿在意的是平叔在二盘这句话之后的沉默。
平叔会沉默的唯一的原因就只能是二盘说出了他的想法。
不过项西无所谓，他见过太多来来去去。
世界这么大，人那么多，在这种很多人根本想象不出的活着的方式里，让人厌恶的某个人发生了什么，谁会在意。
所以自己也没什么可所谓的了。
人有时候就是活个“存在”而已。
医院人很多，项西没想到骨科也会这么多人，在长椅上看着没声的电视看得都睡着两轮了，才终于听到了自己的名字。
展宏图。第四诊室。
他站起来进了第四诊室。
程博衍抬头看到门外进来的患者时愣了愣，那人冲他笑了笑：“大夫眼熟啊，是不是见过？”

“今儿不趴活儿了啊？”程博衍无法形容自己的感受。
“您这话说的，”展宏图一屁股坐到椅子上，声音有些低，“谁乐意满街趴去，这么冷的天。”
“您碰个瓷还碰得挺沧桑啊，”程博衍看了一眼他被冻红的手指，“裤腿撩上去，我看看。”
“哥，别这么说，我也不愿意……我爸病了，”展宏图垂下眼皮轻轻叹了口气，慢慢撩起裤腿，“我总不能看着他死吧。”
展宏图的这句话带着无奈和一丝淡淡的忧伤，程博衍伸出去想检查伤情的手在空中停了停。
“是吗，”他抬头看了展宏图一眼，“你爸什么病？”
展宏图低下了头，过了一会儿才轻声说：“肚子里长了个瘤子。”
“肚子里？”程博衍出于习惯又问了一句，“什么部位？”
“在……在……”展宏图偏开头，捏了捏眉心，“在……胃里。”
“胃里啊？”程博衍看着他，“多久了？化验了没？恶性的？”
项西觉得自己要疯。
张嘴就没实话是他的习惯，但在一个大夫跟前说自己爹长了个瘤子简直就像给自己刨了个坑，摔进去了还得自己填土。
连胃里会不会长瘤都不知道，就出溜了这么一句来。
胃有多大啊？那地儿够不够长个瘤的？
不过看程博衍的反应，是长得下的，但至于多久了，化验，良性恶性什么的他真不知道该怎么回答了。
“就……挺久了，”他眼睛看着窗外，“恶性的，呃……很恶。”
“那……”程博衍看来还打算继续问。
“程大夫，哥，”项西咬着牙，“我……腿疼。”
“你这伤拖的时间有点儿长，”程博衍总算把注意力放回到了他的腿上，“得仔细检查一下，看看有没有移位，这是怎么伤的？”
“被……被要债的人踹伤的，欠了好多钱了，要不我也不能上街干这事啊，”项西说，“我这伤打个绑腿什么的就行了吧？”

“要看检查结果才知道，那天来我就说你这个不是小骨折，你又拖好几天才来，”程博衍皱着眉坐回桌前，拿过检查单低头写着，“情况要是不好，就得住院做手术……姓名，年龄。”
“展宏图，十八……住院？”项西愣了愣，喊了一声，“我不能住院！”
平叔怎么可能让他住院，他要住院了平叔估计能叫人把他从医院拖出去，当初馒头的腿，连医院都没让去，生生是自己长上的。
所以才长歪了。
“为什么不能住院？”程博衍把检查单给他，“拿去交费检查，别再跑了。”
“我不能住院，”项西拧着眉，换上沉痛的表情，“我得……照顾我爸啊。”
小主子，这个章节后面还有哦 ^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢格格不入请大家
content_en:
As for whether he died of cold, poison, or... was slapped to death by Xiang Xi, I don't know, and no one cares. This topic will not be mentioned again until noon at most.
Xiang west washed his hands carefully when washing up.
When putting on his coat, Uncle Ping held the teapot and asked, "Where are you going?"
"Hospital." Xiang west said.
"Didn't you go yesterday?" Uncle Ping stared at him, "If your bones can't be connected, others should say I don't care for you."
"If I can't catch up with you, I won't be able to catch up with you." Xiang Xi opened the door.
Erpan was standing outside the door and was about to come in when he saw him and sneered: "If you can't catch it, you can't catch it. I'll be with you, Brother Mantou."
Xiang Xi glanced at him and curled his lips: "That's all you have."
Before he closed the door and left, he heard Erpan coming into the room and saying loudly to Uncle Ping: "Why keep this thing covered in barbs! Something will happen sooner or later!"
Xiang west spat on the ground. He was not afraid of Erpan. When he was picked up by Uncle Ping, Erpan was still fooling around with someone else.
What still slightly concerned him was Uncle Ping's silence after those words in the second set.
The only reason why Uncle Ping remained silent was because Erpan expressed his thoughts.
But Xiang west doesn't care, he has seen too many come and go.
The world is so big and there are so many people. In this way of life that many people can't even imagine, who cares what happens to someone who is disgusting.
So I have nothing to call myself.
Sometimes people just need to "exist".
There were a lot of people in the hospital. Xiang west didn't expect that there would be so many people in the orthopedics department. He fell asleep on the bench watching the silent TV for two rounds before finally hearing his name.
Expand your ambitions. The fourth clinic.
He stood up and entered the fourth consulting room.
Cheng Boyan looked up and was stunned when he saw the patient coming in from the door. The man smiled at him: "The doctor looks familiar, have you seen him before?"
"Aren't you going to work hard today?" Cheng Boyan couldn't describe his feelings.
"That's what you said," Zhan Hongtu sat down on the chair, his voice a little low, "Who would be willing to lie down in the street in such a cold weather."
"It's quite difficult for you to touch porcelain," Cheng Boyan glanced at his fingers that were red from the cold, "Pull up your trouser legs, let me take a look."
"Brother, don't say that, I don't want to...my dad is sick," Zhan Hongtu lowered his eyelids and sighed softly, slowly lifting his trousers, "I can't watch him die."
Zhan Hongtu's words were filled with helplessness and a touch of sadness. Cheng Boyan's hand that he stretched out to check the injury paused in the air.
"Really?" He raised his head and glanced at Zhan Hongtu, "What's wrong with your dad?"
Zhan Hongtu lowered his head, and after a while he said softly: "There is a tumor in my stomach."
"In the belly?" Cheng Boyan asked again out of habit, "What part?"
"In... in..." Zhan Hongtu tilted his head and pinched his eyebrows, "In... the stomach."
"In the stomach?" Cheng Boyan looked at him, "How long has it been? Has it been tested? Is it malignant?"
Xiang west felt like he was going crazy.
It was his habit to not tell the truth when he opened his mouth, but telling a doctor that his father had a tumor was like digging a hole for himself, and he had to fill it in by himself.
I didn't even know if there would be a tumor in my stomach, so I just said this.
How big is your stomach? Is there enough space for a tumor to grow?
However, judging from Cheng Boyan's reaction, it looked good, but as for how long it had been, whether it had been tested, whether it was benign or malignant, etc., he really didn't know how to answer.
"It's been... for a long time," he looked out the window, "It's vicious, uh... very evil."
"Then..." Cheng Boyan seemed to be planning to continue asking.
"Doctor Cheng, brother," Xiang west gritted his teeth, "My...leg hurts."
"Your injury lasted a little long," Cheng Boyan finally returned his attention to his legs, "Yes.Check carefully to see if there is any displacement. How did it hurt? "
"I was... kicked by a debtor. I owe a lot of money. Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to go out on the street to do this," Xiang west said. "I can just put on leggings or something for this injury, right?" "
"You'll know only after the examination results. I told you that you didn't have a small fracture that day, but you delayed coming for several days." Cheng Boyan frowned and sat back at the table. He took the examination sheet and lowered his head and wrote, "If the condition is not good, you will have to be hospitalized for surgery... Name, age. "
"Zhan Hongtu, eighteen...hospitalized? Xiang west was stunned and shouted, "I can't be hospitalized!" "
How could Uncle Ping let him be hospitalized? If he was going to be hospitalized, Uncle Ping could probably ask someone to drag him out of the hospital. The hospital didn't even let him go to the hospital for his legs. Shengsheng grew them on his own.
That's why it grew crooked.
"Why can't you be hospitalized? Cheng Boyan gave him the inspection sheet, "Take it and pay for the inspection, and don't run away again." "
"I can't be hospitalized," Xiang west frowned and put on a sad expression, "I have to... take care of my dad. "
